  values.length = Ptx.Kernels.HopperDoubleBuffer.fullValueBufferCount tiles →
    tiles ≤ 2 ^ 28 →

        Ptx.IrisExecution.run
              (Ptx.ByteContentsPreparation.transition
                (Ptx.Kernels.HopperDoubleBuffer.fullValueContext a b tiles schedules))
              (Ptx.Kernels.HopperDoubleBuffer.fullValueActions tiles actions)
              (Ptx.Kernels.HopperDoubleBuffer.fullValueInitialState a b tiles schedules frame values) =
            Except.ok final ∧
          final.coupled =
              { protocol := Ptx.Kernels.HopperDoubleBuffer.fullValueReturned values tiles,
                done :=
                  Ptx.Hopper.Progress.Present
                    (Ptx.Kernels.HopperDoubleBuffer.fullValueCandidate a b tiles schedules) } ∧
            Ptx.ByteContentsHeap.Available final ∧
              Ptx.Async.Drain.Returned final.coupled.protocol ∧
                Ptx.Async.Preparation.Live final.coupled.protocol ∧
                  (∀ (lane : Ptx.Hopper.Wgmma.Lane) (slot : Ptx.Hopper.Wgmma.Slot) (index : Fin 4),
                      Ptx.Hopper.ByteContents.valueAt final
                          ({ space := Ptx.ISA.AddressSpace.global,
                                address := Ptx.Kernels.HopperDoubleBuffer.outputWordAddress (lane, slot) }.add
                            ↑index) =
                        some
                          (Ptx.ISA.Symbolic.Byte.realPart Ptx.ISA.Symbolic.Format.f32
                            (Ptx.Kernels.HopperDoubleBuffer.specification a b tiles
                              (Ptx.Hopper.Wgmma.cCoord (lane, slot)))
                            ↑index)) ∧
                    (∀ bid < Ptx.Kernels.HopperDoubleBuffer.fullValueBufferCount tiles,
                        (∃ next, Ptx.Async.reclaim final.coupled.protocol bid = Except.ok next) ∧
                          ∀ (value : ℕ),

                          (Ptx.Kernels.HopperDoubleBuffer.fullValueActions tiles actions))
                        (Ptx.Kernels.HopperDoubleBuffer.fullValueInitialState a b tiles schedules frame values)

∀ (c : Ptx.CopyContract.Config) {l : Ptx.Event.Launch} {execution : Ptx.Event.Candidate} {sources : Ptx.Event.ReadsFrom}

vcs.statement:
∀ {code : List Ptx.Ordered.Instr} {launch : Ptx.Scalar.Launch} {state next : Ptx.Ordered.Client.State} {event bid : ℕ}
  {before after : Ptx.Async.Buffer} {loan : Ptx.Async.Loan},

vcs.name: Ptx.IrisOrderedClient.contract_adequate
vcs.statement:
∀ {code : List Ptx.Ordered.Instr} {launch : Ptx.Scalar.Launch} {pre : Ptx.Scalar.Launch → Prop}
  {domain : Ptx.Scalar.Launch → List Ptx.ISA.Location} {post : Ptx.Scalar.Launch → Ptx.Scalar.ByteMap → Prop}
  {actions : List Ptx.Ordered.Client.Action} {state next : Ptx.Ordered.Client.State}
  {observation : Ptx.Scalar.Observation} {sources : Ptx.Event.ReadsFrom} {co : Ptx.Event.Coherence},
  Ptx.Ordered.Triple code pre domain post →
    pre launch →
      Ptx.Ordered.WellFormed code launch state.source →
        Ptx.Async.Invariant state.protocol →
          Ptx.Ordered.Client.run code launch actions state = Except.ok next →
            Ptx.Ordered.Complete next.source →
              Ptx.Ordered.MemoryConditions next.source launch.initial sources co →
                Ptx.Ordered.ObserverConditions next.source launch.initial sources co observation →
                  observation.domain = domain launch →
                    Iris.ProgramLogic.adequate Iris.Stuckness.NotStuck

                        post launch observation.output ∧
